findings.message: Since PHP 7.0, functions inspecting arguments, like debug_backtrace(), no longer report the original value as passed to a parameter, but will instead provide the current value. The parameter "$result" was used, and possibly changed (by reference), on line 704. (PHP 7.0 behaviour: code that runs on PHP 7 or 8 today already gets this behaviour, so the upgrade changes nothing)
